defmodule DnsResolver.K8s.ServiceDiscovery do
  @moduledoc """
  DNS-based service discovery for Kubernetes internal routing.
  Resolves service names to cluster-internal endpoints and handles
  redirect responses from upstream services.
  """

  require Logger

  @k8s_dns_suffix ".svc.cluster.local"
  @allowed_schemes ["http", "https"]
  @internal_domains ["svc.cluster.local", "pod.cluster.local", "default.svc.cluster.local"]

  defstruct [:resolved_host, :port, :scheme, :path, :query]

  def resolve_and_redirect(conn, service_name, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, endpoint} <- resolve_service(service_name, opts),
         {:ok, response} <- proxy_request(conn, endpoint),
         {:ok, location} <- extract_redirect(response) do
      handle_redirect(conn, location, endpoint)
    else
      {:error, :no_redirect} -> send_proxied_response(conn, response)
      {:error, reason} -> send_error(conn, reason)
    end
  end

  def resolve_service(service_name, opts) do
    namespace = Keyword.get(opts, :namespace, "default")
    port = Keyword.get(opts, :port, 80)
    fqdn = "#{service_name}.#{namespace}#{@k8s_dns_suffix}"

    case :inet_res.lookup(to_charlist(fqdn), :in, :a) do
      [] ->
        Logger.warning("DNS resolution failed for #{fqdn}")
        {:error, :nxdomain}
      [ip | _rest] ->
        host = ip |> :inet.ntoa() |> to_string()
        {:ok, %__MODULE__{resolved_host: host, port: port, scheme: "http", path: "/", query: nil}}
    end
  end

  def proxy_request(conn, endpoint) do
    url = build_url(endpoint)
    headers = forward_headers(conn)
    case HTTPoison.get(url, headers, follow_redirect: false) do
      {:ok, %{status_code: code} = resp} when code in [301, 302, 307, 308] ->
        {:ok, resp}
      {:ok, resp} ->
        {:ok, resp}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:upstream_error, reason}}
    end
  end

  def extract_redirect(%{status_code: code, headers: headers}) when code in [301, 302, 307, 308] do
    case List.keyfind(headers, "Location", 0) || List.keyfind(headers, "location", 0) do
      {_, location} -> {:ok, location}
      nil -> {:error, :no_redirect}
    end
  end
  def extract_redirect(_), do: {:error, :no_redirect}

  @doc """
  Validates redirect location against internal cluster domains.
  Only allows redirects to known-safe internal services.
  """
  def handle_redirect(conn, location, original_endpoint) do
    parsed = URI.parse(location)
    cond do
      is_relative_redirect?(parsed) ->
        # Relative redirects are safe - they stay on the same host
        safe_location = rebuild_relative(parsed, original_endpoint)
        do_redirect(conn, safe_location)

      is_internal_domain?(parsed.host) ->
        # Internal cluster redirect - validate and follow
        do_redirect(conn, location)

      is_same_service_redirect?(parsed, original_endpoint) ->
        # Same resolved IP, different path - safe
        do_redirect(conn, location)

      true ->
        Logger.warning("Blocked external redirect to: #{location}")
        send_error(conn, :blocked_redirect)
    end
  end

  defp is_relative_redirect?(%URI{host: nil, scheme: nil}), do: true
  defp is_relative_redirect?(_), do: false

  defp is_internal_domain?(nil), do: false
  defp is_internal_domain?(host) do
    normalized = String.downcase(host)
    Enum.any?(@internal_domains, fn domain ->
      String.ends_with?(normalized, domain)
    end)
  end

  defp is_same_service_redirect?(%URI{host: host}, %__MODULE__{resolved_host: resolved}) do
    # Compare the redirect target with our resolved endpoint
    # Handle both IP and hostname forms
    case :inet.parse_address(to_charlist(host || "")) do
      {:ok, ip} ->
        resolved_ip = resolved |> to_charlist() |> :inet.parse_address()
        case resolved_ip do
          {:ok, ^ip} -> true
          _ -> false
        end
      {:error, _} ->
        # Not an IP - try DNS resolution to compare
        case :inet_res.lookup(to_charlist(host || ""), :in, :a) do
          [] -> false
          ips -> 
            resolved_ip = resolved |> to_charlist() |> :inet.parse_address()
            case resolved_ip do
              {:ok, rip} -> rip in ips
              _ -> false
            end
        end
    end
  end

  defp rebuild_relative(%URI{path: path, query: query}, endpoint) do
    base = "#{endpoint.scheme}://#{endpoint.resolved_host}:#{endpoint.port}"
    case query do
      nil -> "#{base}#{path}"
      q -> "#{base}#{path}?#{q}"
    end
  end

  defp do_redirect(conn, location) do
    conn
    |> Plug.Conn.put_resp_header("location", location)
    |> Plug.Conn.send_resp(302, "")
  end

  defp send_proxied_response(conn, response) do
    conn |> Plug.Conn.send_resp(response.status_code, response.body)
  end

  defp send_error(conn, _reason) do
    conn |> Plug.Conn.send_resp(502, "Bad Gateway")
  end

  defp build_url(%__MODULE__{scheme: s, resolved_host: h, port: p, path: path, query: nil}) do
    "#{s}://#{h}:#{p}#{path}"
  end
  defp build_url(%__MODULE__{scheme: s, resolved_host: h, port: p, path: path, query: q}) do
    "#{s}://#{h}:#{p}#{path}?#{q}"
  end

  defp forward_headers(conn) do
    conn.req_headers
    |> Enum.filter(fn {k, _} -> k in ["accept", "content-type", "authorization", "x-request-id"] end)
  end
end
